name: Malware Detection with EICAR Test File (T1204.002, internal ref CSCRF-IR-01)
blast_radius: Writes the standard EICAR test string to a per-run temp folder and checks whether endpoint protection removes or flags it. The folder is deleted in undo. Runs only with BAS_CONFIRM_IR_TEST=true.

name: Malicious Address Blocking Capability (CSCRF-IR-03)
blast_radius: Read-only query of outbound firewall block rules.

name: Compromised Account Disablement (T1078, internal ref CSCRF-IR-04)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic local account, disables it, verifies the state, and deletes it in undo. Runs only with BAS_CONFIRM_IR_TEST=true.

name: Security Log Evidence Export (CSCRF-IR-06)
blast_radius: Exports the Security log to a per-run temp file (read only against the log) and deletes the export in undo.
